brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: 4 pieces placed: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,-1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full - contiguous 4-cell cluster

requirements.requirement: water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: No run installed. Attempts to route a single run through all four cells were refused ROUTE_NO_PATH by configurator (e.g. 0,1->0,0->1,0->1,-1). With third-depth bins installed, clash MESH_CLASH occurred. Brief asks for through-base feed to every cell which is not achievable with current route rules; build left with bases only, meshClash clear.

finish.summary: 4-cell base cluster built as planter. Continuous water pipe through all four bases could not be placed due to configurator routing rules - requirement unmet.
